label: prop:tau-M-asymptotic-rep-theory
title: $\mathrm{tr}_M^{V_\lambda}(\beta) = \mathrm{Tr}\,\rho_\lambda(\beta) \cdot \cos(\alpha_\lambda - b_\lambda\hbar_q^2/2) \cdot \prod_k(1 + c_k^{(\lambda)} u_\lambda^k)$: canonical $u$-ladder of the Markov-traced character
html:
Proposition. \mathrm{tr}_M^{V_\lambda}(\beta) = \mathrm{Tr}\,\rho_\lambda(\beta) \cdot \cos(\alpha_\lambda - b_\lambda\hbar_q^2/2) \cdot \prod_k(1 + c_k^{(\lambda)} u_\lambda^k): canonical u-ladder of the Markov-traced character

\mathrm{tr}_M ladder — representation-theoretic structure.

Proposition (conditional on the open recursion kernel of prop:q-beta-c-k-recursion-from-habiro-q-difference; "\mathrm{tr}_M ladder").

For a typed braid \beta and a Hecke irreducible representation V_\lambda of H_n(q), the Markov-traced character at single wrap admits a canonical factorisation in the substrate ladder variable u_\lambda = b_\lambda\,\hbar_q^2 (where \hbar_q = (q-1)/q):

\boxed{
  \mathrm{tr}_M^{V_\lambda}(\beta)
   \;=\;
   \mathrm{Tr}\,\rho_\lambda(\beta) \cdot
   \cos\!\Bigl(\alpha_\lambda - \tfrac{b_\lambda \hbar_q^2}{2}\Bigr) \cdot
   \prod_{k \geq 2}\bigl(1 + c_k^{(\lambda)}\, u_\lambda^{\,k}\bigr),
}

This matches the canonical \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision ladder (prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder), where:

  • \rho_\lambda is the Hoefsmit seminormal representation of H_n(q) on V_\lambda.
  • b_\lambda is the off-diagonal coupling of \rho_\lambda(\sigma_i) in the standard-tableau basis. For V_{(2,1)} of H_3, the scalar b = \sqrt{q^4+q^2+1}/(q^2+1) = \sqrt{d_1 d_2 + 1} from prop:hoefsmit-V21-cos-symmetrization.
  • \alpha_\lambda is the single-wrap eigenphase on V_\lambda. The \cos(\alpha_\lambda - b_\lambda\hbar_q^2/2) envelope carries the N=1 coupling b_\lambda.
  • c_k^{(\lambda)} are the rung coefficients of the ladder, representing the higher Ohtsuki invariants of the correction factor.

The factorisation defines the correction factor F_\lambda := \mathrm{tr}_M^{V_\lambda}(\beta) / \mathrm{Tr}\,\rho_\lambda(\beta), which is valid wherever \mathrm{Tr}\,\rho_\lambda(\beta) \neq 0. We establish the \hbar_q-parity and the determination of the rung coefficients. The ladder is even in \hbar_q because only even powers survive Markov-cyclicity invariance under the bar involution q \leftrightarrow q^{-1} (prop:q-beta-cos-resummation).

The rung coefficients are not free. They are determined by the proved second-order q-difference (Hahn–Exton q-Bessel) recursion of prop:q-beta-c-k-recursion-from-habiro-q-difference. The entire product forms the Taylor expansion of the exact finite Habiro sum, which the production system evaluates without truncation (prop:habiro-precision-ladder-equivalence).

N=1 envelope \cos(\alpha - b\hbar_q^2/2), coupling b proved (Hoefsmit \tilde f_1 matrix element)
k = 2 c_2 = -1, factor (1 - b^2\hbar_q^4) proved seed (bar-even); wired (\mathfrak{Q}_\beta production)
k = 3 c_3 \approx -2, factor (1 - 2b^3\hbar_q^6) near-match (recursion + open kernel)
k \geq 4 c_k^{(\lambda)} recursion-generated; kernel open
